mechanics.title: Ascend the Peak
mechanics.description: The party gathers at the foot of the mountain and must reach the top to activate the objective.

mechanics.title: Mission Definitions
mechanics.description: Categories: Story, Tutorial, Optional, Daily, Secret. Earn Rift Shards on completion.

mechanics.title: Mission Discovery
mechanics.description: Missions are found by exploring zones, not just listed — supports the exploration-first pillar.

mechanics.title: Co-op Mission Sync
mechanics.description: Shared mission state across the party. Open: real-time vs at-completion; who is authority.

mechanics.title: Collect Resources
mechanics.description: Gather objectives scattered across a zone.

mechanics.title: Rescue Stranded Critter
mechanics.description: Find a stranded critter before he dies.

mechanics.title: Mission Board
mechanics.description: Pick a mission to start with your party. NOTE: tension with the exploration-first pillar — decide board vs in-world discovery vs both.

mechanics.title: PvE / PvP Zones
mechanics.description: Hub disables trolling. Starter biome is PvE; others are PvP.

mechanics.title: Daily Challenge Modifiers
mechanics.description: Randomly generated mountain with modifiers (low gravity, slow regen, etc.).

mechanics.title: Interaction Puzzle
mechanics.description: Place an orb on a pedestal to extend a bridge / open a door.

mechanics.title: Co-op Challenge
mechanics.description: A challenge players must work together to solve.

mechanics.title: Climbing Gym / Tutorial
mechanics.description: Basic climbing challenges over climbable/walkable surfaces — the FTUE.
